description: Graphite sketch of a bowl of fruit. Line drawing with no shading. The bowl of fruit is located on the lower left hand side of the paper. Behind the bowl of fruit is window, a rectangular shape that begins at the middle top of the paper and extends down and over to the right side of the paper. In the foreground, in front of the bowl of fruit there is a unidentifiable object that looks like a small plate with two jagged horn like protrusions coming out of the top and sticking straight up.
title: Untitled (Bowl of Fruit)
